question: The correct electronic configuration of Cu is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**[Ar]3d104s1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Copper (Cu):-**

 
 
• It is a transition metal with atomic number 29.
 
• **The correct electronic configuration of Cu is [Ar]3d104s1**.
 
• The electronic configuration of Cu can be determined by filling electrons in the increasing order of energy levels and orbitals. 
 
• Cu has a unique electronic configuration due to the presence of a completely filled d-orbital, which gives it stability and makes it less reactive. .
